text: dsh-balance-plugin 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的余额与用量侧栏组件。它在侧栏底部加入按钮和浮层，并由 DSH 服务端路由读取 DeepSeek API 余额及本地会话日志。用户可以查看余额、充值与赠金金额、今日或累计的输入和输出 token、缓存读取量及模型调用次数。今日统计按北京时间计算，用量只汇总 deepseek-official provider。适合希望在 DSH 网页中查看 DeepSeek 账户和使用情况的人；需要配置可由 DSH credentials 服务解析的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并需要系统 zstd 命令读取压缩日志。

dsh-balance-plugin adds a DSH web sidebar panel for DeepSeek balance and usage. It shows balances and token totals from local sessions. Daily totals use Beijing time; only deepseek-official usage is counted. It needs a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in DSH credentials and zstd for compressed logs.
想直接在 DSH 网页侧栏看 DeepSeek 账户还剩多少余额。
能不能按今天统计我用了多少输入和输出 token？

How can I see my DeepSeek API balance inside the DSH web interface?
Show me today's or all-time DeepSeek token usage from my DSH sessions.
dsh-balance-plugin 的功能「余额查看」：从 DSH credentials 服务解析 DeepSeek API key 并请求账户余额。打开侧栏按钮后加载数据，面板显示余额、充值金额和赠金金额。
dsh-balance-plugin 的功能「会话用量汇总」：解压 DSH 会话日志，按 deepseek-official 汇总输入、输出、缓存读取 token 和调用次数，并在面板展示。
dsh-balance-plugin 的功能「日期范围切换」：侧栏面板可切换今日或全部历史用量；今日范围按北京时间当天起点过滤会话消息。
dsh-balance-plugin 的功能「侧栏余额面板」：在网页侧栏底部注册余额按钮，点击后显示浮层，并提供手动刷新和关闭操作。

dsh-balance-plugin README · dsh-balance-plugin：[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web plugin: shows **DeepSeek API balance** and **token usage** at the bottom of the web sidebar (port 3080), with a **Today / All-time** toggle, filtered by provider (only `deepseek-official`, ignoring other vendors).

dsh-balance-plugin README · Features：- 💰 Balance: calls DeepSeek's official `GET /user/balance`, reusing dsh's credentials (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) — no manual key entry
- 📊 Token usage: reads dsh session logs (`session.jsonl.zstd`), aggregates by provider
  - Uncached input / cache read / output / model call count
- 🔄 Today / All-time toggle: today (Beijing time) or full history
- 🎨 Auto-adapts to light/dark theme

dsh-balance-plugin README · Install (from the plugin market)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-balance-plugin
```

Restart `dsh web`, then refresh the page — a balance button appears at the bottom of the sidebar.

dsh-balance-plugin README · Architecture：```
Browser (3080 page)
  client.js ──fetch──▶ /dsh-balance/data?scope=today|all
                              │
node side (index.js, inside the dsh process)

- `index.js`: node-side cordis plugin, registers HTTP route `/dsh-balance/data`
- `client.js`: browser-side plugin, injects into `sidebar.footer.action` (sidebar bottom button + floating panel)
- `package.json`: `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client.platform: "web"` + `exports["./client"]`
- `cordis.patch.yml`: bundle patch registering the node entry

dsh-balance-plugin README · Manual install：```sh
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-balance-plugin
cp index.js client.js cordis.patch.yml package.json ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-balance-plugin/
```

Then add to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-balance
      name: dsh-balance-plugin
```

Restart `dsh web` and refresh the browser.

dsh-balance-plugin README · Dependencies：- node side: Node built-ins only (`node:fs`, `node:child_process`, `node:path`); requires the `zstd` CLI for decompressing session logs
- browser side: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` (peer dep, ships with dsh 0.1.0-rc.6)

dsh-balance-plugin README · Pack：```sh
npm pack   # produces dsh-balance-plugin-0.1.0.tgz
```
